scopeDecisions.decision: Fireemu's capability-protected control command delivers caller-supplied version data to local v1 and v2 handlers in both profiles. Production event delivery is still planned.

The loopback control listener provides client-template administration for the default project using the local control capability. It covers current and historical reads, structural validation, conditional publishing, history and rollback. Formal coverage and comparison remain planned for the full conditions below.

The loopback control listener serves the firebase-server namespace with its own history and the server-template data plane the Node Admin SDK reads, following shapes recorded in production on 2026-11-21 and 2026-11-24: the recorded percent, custom-signal string, numeric and semantic-version atoms and their && chains are converted to the structured form, group parameters are listed with the top-level parameters, and the strict profile refuses the recorded two-term OR, NOT, true and false conditions. Other expressions become an empty condition.

Client-template publishes and rollbacks through the local administration deliver the recorded v1 and v2 event shapes through ordinary Functions delivery, with one event id per version shared by both generations and an optional configured updateUser in the recorded shapes. Server-namespace publishes deliver nothing, as production delivered none within five minutes on 2026-11-24 while client events arrived; duplicate delivery and ordering were observed once-and-in-order for five chained publishes only.

supportingRecordings.role: Supporting evidence only (coordinator ruling 1, D1): the sanitised RC-OBSERVE-V2-3 recording of 2026-11-24, compared with local strict and emulator runs of the same recorder plan by conformance/src/remote-config-production/evidence.mjs. The two closure passes are separate recordings.

conditions.description: Read the current client and server templates and their version and ETag metadata. Check empty projects, unknown namespaces, permission failures and isolation between projects. Includes the defaults download in JSON, XML and property-list form (coordinator ruling D7).
Validate parameters, parameter groups and condition references. Compare errors and confirm that validation-only requests leave the current template, history and event stream unchanged.
Publish templates with a matching, missing, stale or wildcard If-Match value. Compare response metadata, version creation and the stored template after concurrent accepted or refused updates.
List template versions and follow continuation tokens. Compare version-specific reads, rollback to an existing version, and refusal of an unavailable version without a state change.

Exercise one pinned client SDK with defaults, supported condition matches, changed and unchanged fetches, and activation of fetched values. Capture the SDK requests and exact response shapes before defining the local endpoint contract.
Retrieve the server template through a pinned Admin SDK and compare typed parameters, defaults and evaluation with condition signals in its supported scope.
Observe notification and reconnect behavior when a newer client template is published, including when the fetched values are unchanged.

Observe which accepted template operations invoke v1 and v2 Functions handlers, and compare version metadata, event envelopes and delivery. Existing injection tests exercise the caller-supplied local event path.
